svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: The gate scripts on five events of a Claude Code session
GATES THAT BLOCK — deny on PreToolUse, block on Stop

g.text: Blocks — three rules, each can refuse alone
The only exceptions: config.json and eval/**.
Refused before and after approval; links followed.
With gatebound spec files in spec/ and 05-gate.md
not approved ok, writes off the allowlist are refused.
A worker writes only inside task.json write_scope.
No docs allowlist. Unreadable scope is refused.
The prompt must carry a gatebound-scope
Refused when the fence is missing,
breaks a field rule, or overlaps a
scope already active in this session.

svg.text: Blocks — a turn end with the contract unmet: any criterion that is fail or unverified.
Runs the contract only when .gatebound/contract.json exists and active_pipeline is build or verify; otherwise allows and records unverified. Never blocks when stop_hook_active.
When block_count reaches 3, the session may end.
A gate that cannot be satisfied must not
and that value is never blank.
Once spent, no new criterion starts.
Deferred ones do not block, but are not ok:
recorded unverified, run first next turn end.
Under verify, everything runs: no tiers, no budget.
Once a settled job has its verdict recorded
(hand-off check ok, or final_verdict after 3 blocks)
later turn ends run nothing and are allowed.
a new job, a redelegated task.
Tasks ended by jobs stop: fail, not blocked.
GATES THAT NEVER BLOCK — record, then allow

g.text: a context block of at most 600 chars.
A gatebound build or verify skill records
gate. Any other skill leaves the
Write-type calls are only noted as writes.
Does — build state into a file
With a build in progress, stamps job
and task states into its own section

svg.text: A block is JSON on stdout, never an exit code.
An exception leaves one line in .gatebound/runs/hook-errors.log.
A broken hook degrades to "allow and log"; it never kills the session.
The plugin installs globally, so hooks fire in every project.
prompt, skill, spawn, question and stop allow without creating state.
compact does nothing: there is no build in progress.
In write, bash and powershell, rule (a) applies only with gatebound spec
files, rule (b) only in a worker. Rule (c) applies everywhere, always.
Each gate finishes within 5 s on a normal project (hook timeout 10 s). Only the Stop hook has timeout 600 s; the gate cuts the contract run at 570 s.
